identity.name: Field Blade
identity.description: Each affordable normal melee activation costs 1 stamina; damage targets the current enemy. Piercing bypasses that amount of enemy block. Ordinary attacks activate once per round; explicit extra-activation effects may repeat them.
identity.lore: A caravan guard's first honest wages bought its iron.

effects.description: Deal physical damage to the current enemy.
effects.condition: Item is packed and all activation costs are affordable.

visual.brief: A workmanlike narrow iron blade with a blunt clipped point, plain straight guard and brown wrapped grip. Broad neutral steel planes; no colored reflections.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
